title: Foundation: accounts, access and rules
opens_when: Environment reset to seed state; only the Super Admin account exists with a known password and TOTP secret.

steps.does: Sign in with the seeded account and TOTP code. Look at the home screen and the sidebar.
steps.expect: Lands on /home with Super Admin widgets (pending invitations, failed jobs, backup status). Sidebar shows Admin and Reports only; no Procurement, Inventory, Production, Sales, Finance or Service modules.

steps.does: Open /admin/users and invite the seven staff accounts (MG, PI, IS, FS, AT1, AT2, QI), each with the matching role template.
steps.expect: Seven rows with status invited; seven invitation emails arrive in the mail sink within 60 seconds; each contains a link and no password.

steps.does: Each agent opens its own invitation email, follows the link, sets a password, enrols the authenticator, saves recovery codes and lands on home (agents work in parallel, each in its own browser session).
steps.expect: Each lands on its own role home (technicians on /production/queue). Sidebar matches the role map in the workflow document section 2. Profile status becomes active.

steps.does: Open /admin/approval-rules and set the test limits: requisition 20,000; PO 50,000; stock write-off 1,000; discount over 5%; expense 500; supplier payment 30,000; supplier bank change always; period close always. Use Test rule with 49,999 and 50,000 for PO.
steps.expect: Test rule names Management as approver only for 50,000 and above. Rules saved and audited.

steps.does: In /admin/settings add exchange rate USD to GHS (test value 12.00, source “UAT”), tax rates (test values) and three cost centres; confirm locations, defect codes and chart of accounts exist.
steps.expect: Entries saved; a duplicate rate for the same source and date is refused; the six seeded locations are present.

steps.does: Open AT2 in /admin/users, press Edit scopes, add qc.inspect as an extra scope, review the before/after diff and save.
steps.expect: Diff lists only qc.inspect as added; Management receives an email about the change; AT2’s new scope appears after Revoke sessions and a fresh sign-in.

steps.does: Type the addresses /procurement/orders/new, /finance/invoices and /sales/orders.
steps.expect: Each shows the 403 page naming the missing capability; none shows data. Request access emails the Super Admin.

title: Master data and opening stock
opens_when: All seven accounts active; approval rules and rates configured (P0).

steps.does: Open /admin/imports, download the Items template, upload items_with_errors.csv and press Validate.
steps.expect: Row-level errors with reasons (invalid kind, duplicate SKU, missing name, negative weight). Nothing is written; Commit is disabled.

steps.does: Upload items.csv, Validate, Commit.
steps.expect: 13 items created (12 components plus the finished laptop) with tracking modes as in the file; batch status committed.

steps.does: Import suppliers.csv (three suppliers) through the wizard.
steps.expect: Three suppliers in status pending_verification.

steps.does: Import accounts.csv (departments and one staff account).
steps.expect: Four accounts active with credit limits.

steps.does: Open the first two suppliers, complete the checklist, press Mark active, and add warranty terms (12 months from receipt).
steps.expect: Suppliers 1 and 2 active; supplier 3 left pending on purpose for P2-09. Warranty terms saved.

steps.does: Open the finished laptop and create BOM version 1 in the editor: add the 12 components (RAM quantity 2). Press Save draft, then Submit for approval.
steps.expect: BOM status pending_approval; Management notified; IS cannot approve its own submission.

steps.does: Open the Approvals inbox from the bell, open the BOM request, check lines and cost, press Approve.
steps.expect: BOM becomes active; IS notified. Exactly one active version exists.

steps.does: In /inventory/reorder set policies for all components (minimum equals two laptop sets). Import opening_stock.csv (four laptop sets with serial numbers) through the wizard.
steps.expect: Opening ledger rows at WH-MAIN; serial-tracked items have component serials; stock on hand equals the file totals.

steps.does: IS plans a full count for WH-MAIN and starts it. IS and QI count by scanning; QI deliberately counts one RAM module fewer. IS submits for review, accepts variances and posts.
steps.expect: One variance of −1 RAM shown with value; adjustment (below the 1,000 limit) posted; ledger shows the adjustment row; count status posted.

steps.does: Open the stock valuation report and compare with the opening values.
steps.expect: Valuation equals opening stock cost less the adjustment.

title: Replenishment and purchasing
opens_when: Opening stock posted; suppliers 1 and 2 active; reorder policies set.

steps.does: From the home widget open Reorder suggestions, select the below-minimum rows and press Create requisition from selected.
steps.expect: Requisition draft with source reorder and lines prefilled.

steps.does: Open the requisition and press Submit (value above 20,000).
steps.expect: Status submitted; Management notified in-app.

steps.does: Approvals inbox › open › Approve.
steps.expect: Requisition approved; Procurement notified; Convert to PO becomes available to PI.

steps.does: Open the requisition and press Convert to PO. Choose supplier 1 (USD). First change currency to EUR to test the missing-rate prompt, then return to USD. Save draft and Submit for approval.
steps.expect: EUR shows “No rate for EUR on [date]”; USD fills the rate automatically; PO status pending_approval (above 50,000); Management notified.

steps.does: Approve the PO from the inbox.
steps.expect: PO approved; PI notified.

steps.does: Press Send to supplier, then Record confirmation with supplier reference and dates.
steps.expect: PDF generated and emailed to the supplier in the mail sink; status sent then confirmed; PDF shows PO number, supplier, lines, totals, incoterm.

steps.does: PI presses Amend on the PO (increase one line) and submits; MG approves; PI resends.
steps.expect: New version created; approval requested again; resend emails the new PDF; version history visible.

steps.does: Create a small PO to supplier 2 (local, GHS, below limit) for packaging boxes; Submit; Send; Confirm.
steps.expect: Submit approves immediately (no Management step); sent and confirmed.

steps.does: Try to create a PO for supplier 3 (still pending verification).
steps.expect: Blocked with a message that the supplier must be active; no PO created.

steps.does: PI requests a bank detail change on supplier 1; FS presses Verify (call-back ticked); MG approves in the inbox.
steps.expect: Request moves requested, verified, approved; new details applied; PI and FS notified. While not yet approved, payments to this supplier are blocked (checked again in P5-05).

steps.does: On the PO press Create shipment. Enter mode sea, BL number, two containers, carrier, forwarder, agent, ports, ETD, ETA, free days 14. Press Create shipment.
steps.expect: Shipment booked with number; lines carry PO quantities; ETA stored as original ETA.

steps.does: Press Mark departed, add a transhipment event, then Update ETA to five days later.
steps.expect: Status in_transit; events on timeline; ETA slip of 5 days notifies Management and Inventory (threshold 3).

steps.does: Each agent checks the bell, opens the notification, and opens /imports/shipments?filter=delayed.
steps.expect: Notification present once per recipient; list shows slippage in days; board column correct.

steps.does: Add charges as estimates: freight USD, insurance USD, clearing fee GHS (basis quantity), local transport GHS (basis weight). Leave shipment weights empty.
steps.expect: Charges saved with currency, rate, basis, estimated status; GHS equivalents computed at the stored rate.

steps.does: Upload bill of lading, invoice and packing list; also try a renamed executable and the EICAR test file.
steps.expect: Valid files show Scanning then Clean and tick the checklist; executable and EICAR are blocked with a clear message.

steps.does: Add the event Arrived. (Orchestrator then advances the clock 9 days.)
steps.expect: Status arrived; free-days clock starts; after the clock shift a demurrage alert (3 days or fewer left) reaches PI and Management.

steps.does: Start customs entry; press Mark lodged, Mark queried with a reason, Release hold, Mark assessed (duty, VAT, levies), Mark paid, Mark released, then Mark cleared on the shipment.
steps.expect: Queried sets shipment held and notifies MG and IS; assessed creates duty and levy charges as actual; released then cleared moves status to cleared.

steps.does: Replace freight and clearing estimates with invoiced amounts using Mark actual.
steps.expect: Estimates become actual; a change after a posted landed-cost run would require a new run.

steps.does: Press Mark delivered.
steps.expect: Status delivered; a goods receipt draft with expected lines is created; Inventory notified.

steps.does: Create a second, small air shipment (supplier 1) for fans and Wi-Fi cards, record weights, add charges with basis weight, run it to delivered.
steps.expect: Air shipment follows the same flow; weight-based charge allocates once weights exist.

title: Receiving and incoming inspection
opens_when: Goods receipt drafts exist from P3-09 and P3-10; local PO from P2-08 confirmed.

steps.does: From the home widget open the expected receipt. Scan items and enter quantities; short-ship one line by one unit.
steps.expect: Scan adds or increments lines; unknown barcode shows Not found; item not on PO shows Not on this PO with confirm.

steps.does: Capture serials for CPU, motherboard, RAM and SSD lines. Try a duplicate serial, then a wrong count.
steps.expect: Duplicate refused with link to the existing record; Post receipt stays disabled until counts match.

steps.does: Mark one SSD as rejected (dead on arrival) with reason and photo. Press Request inspection for lines whose items require it.
steps.expect: Reject quantity recorded; receipt status inspecting; Quality Inspector notified.

steps.does: Open Incoming inspections, inspect the CPU line (Accept) and the SSD line (Reject with defect code).
steps.expect: Accept releases the line; Reject keeps the quantity as rejected; Inventory notified.

steps.does: Press Post receipt and read the confirmation.
steps.expect: Confirmation lists rows to be written. After posting: accepted goods in warehouse, rejected SSD in quarantine, lots and serials created, PO and shipment quantities updated, variance banner shown, Procurement and Finance notified.

steps.does: In a second browser tab press Post receipt again on the same receipt (and double-click once).
steps.expect: Second attempt shows “Already posted”; ledger rows are not duplicated.

steps.does: On the posted receipt press Open supplier RMA for the rejected SSD; submit to supplier, record authorisation, mark shipped, record credit note.
steps.expect: RMA moves through states; stock leaves quarantine on Mark shipped; credit recorded.

steps.does: Receive the local PO from supplier 2 (no shipment) and post it.
steps.expect: Receipt posts without a shipment; lots recorded; PO received.

steps.does: Check PO status for the short-shipped line; use Close short with a reason.
steps.expect: PO status partly_received then closed short; remaining quantity cancelled; audit entry present.

title: Landed cost, supplier invoices and payments
opens_when: Receipts for the shipment posted (P4-05); charges are actual.

steps.does: On the shipment press Run landed cost. In the draft change the local transport basis to weight (no weights recorded) and press Recalculate; then change it to value.
steps.expect: Weight basis without weights shows an error naming the charge; value basis allocates; table shows share, added cost, new unit cost and effect on average cost.

steps.does: Press Post landed cost and read the confirmation.
steps.expect: Lot and unit costs update; cost history appended; run status posted; FS and MG notified; allocations equal each charge exactly.

steps.does: Open the item stock detail for the SSD and its cost history tab; later open the journal.
steps.expect: Cost history shows the landed-cost event; within 60 seconds journal entries for the receipt and the landed cost exist and balance.

steps.does: Create a supplier invoice (supplier 1) from the shipment, Run match with a deliberate price difference on one line, then Approve for payment.
steps.expect: Variance flagged; approval for payment goes to Management; after MG approves, status approved.

steps.does: FS tries Record payment before the bank change from P2-10 is approved (if still pending), then after approval records the payment above the 30,000 limit; MG approves.
steps.expect: Before approval: blocked with the bank-change message. After: payment goes to Management, then clears; journals post; supplier invoice paid.

steps.does: Record a cash payment to supplier 2 below the limit.
steps.expect: Payment clears immediately; journal entry exists.

steps.does: Press Close shipment. Expect it to be refused first (a required document or an estimated charge remains); fix and close.
steps.expect: First attempt disabled or refused with the reason; after fixing, the shipment closes.

steps.does: Reverse the landed-cost run (reason), check costs restore, run and post again.
steps.expect: Reversal restores prior costs; second run posts; cost history shows three events; journals balance.

steps.does: Open the landed cost versus estimate report and the shipment status report.
steps.expect: Figures match recorded charges and allocations (Verifier checks).

title: Production and quality
opens_when: Components costed in stock; BOM active; local replenishment received when needed.

steps.does: Create an assembly order for 10 laptops: Save draft, Plan, Check materials.
steps.expect: Status awaiting_materials with a shortage table (RAM short by 4).

steps.does: IS presses Create requisition for shortage and Submit (below limit, auto-approved). PI converts to a local PO to supplier 2, sends and confirms. Orchestrator advances one day. IS receives and posts.
steps.expect: Requisition linked to the assembly order; local PO; receipt posts; stock rises by 4 RAM.

steps.does: Open the assembly order, press Check materials again, then Release.
steps.expect: Status ready then released; 10 unit records with build references; materials reserved; technicians notified.

steps.does: Press Issue materials, scan the component serials for all ten sets, press Post issue.
steps.expect: Ledger issue rows move parts to assembly WIP; serial statuses issued; order in_progress.

steps.does: Both technicians open their queue at the same moment and press Claim next unit.
steps.expect: Each receives a different unit; no unit is assigned twice.

steps.does: Work unit 1 step by step: Start step, checklist, Scan component installed (first scan a serial that was not issued), Complete step, Record imaging, Record test for POST and burn-in, Submit for QC.
steps.expect: Unissued serial refused; each step records time; genealogy rows created with serial, lot and cost; Submit for QC enabled only after tests pass; unit qc_hold; Quality notified.

steps.does: Work unit 2 the same way in parallel with AT1.
steps.expect: No interference; both units progress; board updates live.

steps.does: On unit 3 press Report problem (faulty display) and replace it by scanning a spare from stock.
steps.expect: Unit shows blocked then resumes; genealogy replaces the display (old row closed with reason); Inventory notified.

steps.does: On unit 4 record a failed burn-in test and try Submit for QC; then repair, retest passed, submit.
steps.expect: Submit disabled with reason after the fail; enabled after a pass.

steps.does: Inspect unit 1: review spec versus actual, add no defects, press Pass and read the confirmation; print the label.
steps.expect: Final serial UPSA-LAP-year-number assigned; cost snapshot; finished-goods ledger row; unit in_stock; label PDF correct; Inventory notified.

steps.does: Inspect unit 4: add a defect (cosmetic scratch) and press Fail.
steps.expect: Rework order created; unit rework; technician notified; defect analytics updated.

steps.does: AT1 opens Rework, Start rework, Mark fixed, retests, Submit for QC; QI passes it.
steps.expect: Unit returns to testing then qc_hold then in_stock; history shows both inspections.

steps.does: AT2 opens the inspection page for unit 2 (which AT2 built) and tries Pass.
steps.expect: Blocked: “You worked on this unit and cannot inspect it”; no inspection row created.

steps.does: QI records a Conditional result on unit 5 (minor cosmetic). Management opens it and presses Override and accept.
steps.expect: Unit stays qc_hold after QI; Management notified; after override the unit proceeds with the defect noted; audit shows who overrode.

steps.does: Finish units 6 to 10: build, test, inspect. Leave unit 9 failing twice; IS and MG decide to scrap it.
steps.expect: Eight units pass; unit 9 scrapped with approval and e-waste record (if enabled); order completes automatically when all units are finalised or scrapped.

steps.does: Read yields on the assembly order, the defects analytics and the buildable view.
steps.expect: Yield equals passed over built; defects by code and supplier correct; buildable reflects remaining stock.

title: Internal sales, dispatch, invoicing and payment
opens_when: At least 8 finished units in stock (P6); accounts active; list price set.

steps.does: Create an order for Dept of IT: 4 laptops with a 12% discount (above the 5% rule). Save draft and Submit.
steps.expect: Status pending_approval; Management notified; stock check shows 4 available.

steps.does: MG presses Reject with a comment. IS reads the comment, lowers the discount to 4%, resubmits; MG sees it no longer needs approval (or approves).
steps.expect: Rejected order returns to draft with the comment; resubmission below the limit becomes approved without Management.

steps.does: Press Reserve units and pick four serials. In a second tab create another order and try to reserve one of the same serials.
steps.expect: First order holds the units; second attempt is refused with “already reserved”; only one active reservation per unit.

steps.does: Create a dispatch. Scan a serial not reserved for this order, then the correct four; Mark picked; Dispatch.
steps.expect: Wrong serial refused; ledger dispatch rows; units dispatched; order dispatched; Finance notified “ready to invoice”.

steps.does: Press Record handover with recipient name, phone and a signature.
steps.expect: Dispatch delivered; warranty created per unit starting today (12 months); delivery email to the account contact.

steps.does: Open invoices to issue, create a tax invoice from the dispatch and press Issue with Email to contact ticked.
steps.expect: Invoice numbered; PDF totals add up; prices equal the order snapshot; email sent; journals for receivable, revenue, VAT and cost of sales exist.

steps.does: Record a part payment by bank transfer and allocate; then try to allocate more than the balance; then record the remainder.
steps.expect: Invoice part_paid then paid; over-allocation blocked; journals post.

steps.does: Create an order for Dept of Finance for 8 laptops (more than in stock). Submit, Reserve what exists, press Request build for the shortfall.
steps.expect: Reservations for available units; assembly order created for the shortfall; order awaiting_build; later (after build) the remaining units auto-reserve and the order becomes ready.

steps.does: MG changes the list price of the laptop. IS opens the earlier order and creates a new order.
steps.expect: Earlier order and its invoice keep the old price; the new order uses the new price.

steps.does: FS puts the Registry account on hold; IS tries to create an order for it; FS reactivates.
steps.expect: Order creation blocked with the hold message; works again after reactivation.

steps.does: Cancel an approved order that has reservations.
steps.expect: Reason required; reservations released; units back in stock; cancellation audited.

steps.does: IS creates a return for one dispatched unit and submits; MG approves; IS receives it by scan and records the condition as damaged; FS creates the credit note.
steps.expect: Return requested, approved, received into quarantine; credit note linked to the invoice; journals post.

steps.does: Transfer 2 components from the main warehouse to the repair bench; ship; receive with one missing.
steps.expect: Transfer in_transit then received; shortfall asks for a reason and offers Create adjustment.

steps.does: IS submits a write-off above 1,000 (MG approves) and one below 1,000.
steps.expect: Above limit: pending_approval then posted after MG; below limit: posted immediately; ledger and journals correct.

steps.does: Run a cycle count of the finished-goods location with QI as witness.
steps.expect: Count matches system; accuracy figure recorded; no adjustment needed.

steps.does: Scan a delivered unit’s serial in the warranty register; read status, genealogy and supplier coverage; press Open ticket; assign to AT1.
steps.expect: Warranty active with correct dates; coverage shown per component; ticket received with SLA; AT1 notified.

steps.does: Open the ticket: Start diagnosis, save diagnosis (faulty SSD, covered), Add part by scan, Consume parts, Start repair, Retest and record tests.
steps.expect: Ledger service-consume row; genealogy closes the old SSD and links the new one to the ticket; tests recorded.

steps.does: Retest the repaired unit where required and record a pass.
steps.expect: Ticket allows Mark ready for collection after pass.

steps.does: Mark ready for collection, then Record collection.
steps.expect: Email to the account contact; ticket closed; covered repair posts at zero charge with cost captured; journals post.

steps.does: Open supplier RMA from the repaired ticket (faulty SSD within supplier warranty) and take it through to credit.
steps.expect: RMA linked to ticket; credit recorded.

steps.does: Orchestrator backdates another unit’s warranty so it is expired. FS opens a ticket; the system shows expired; FS sets not covered, creates a quote, sends it, records approval; AT1 repairs; FS collects and invoices.
steps.expect: Billable path: quote PDF and email; approval recorded; repair; invoice created from the ticket.

steps.does: FS requests goodwill cover on a third expired unit; MG approves from the inbox.
steps.expect: Approval recorded; coverage goodwill; repair proceeds at zero charge.

steps.does: Open a ticket for a non-UPSA device (description and serial typed in) and run it as a paid repair.
steps.expect: Ticket works without genealogy; invoice produced.

steps.does: Extend one warranty with a reason; void another.
steps.expect: End date moves or status void; both audited; lookup reflects the change.

steps.does: Orchestrator advances the clock past an open ticket’s SLA.
steps.expect: SLA at-risk then breached notifications reach FS and MG once each.

steps.does: AT1 submits a small expense (below 500); IS submits one above 500; MG approves the second; FS marks both paid.
steps.expect: Below limit approves immediately; above limit pending then approved; paid links a payment; AT1 sees only own expenses.

steps.does: Set a budget for a cost centre; open budget versus actual and drill into the lines behind a figure.
steps.expect: Actual equals the ledger lines; drill-down lists the entries.

steps.does: Create a manual journal that does not balance, then a balanced one; reverse it.
steps.expect: Save is disabled while unbalanced; balanced entry posts; reversal posts in the current period.

steps.does: Record a receipt without allocating; confirm it appears under Unallocated; allocate it.
steps.expect: Unallocated list shows it, then clears after allocation.

steps.does: Leave one supplier invoice in draft. Open the close checklist, see it fail, fix the item, Request close; MG approves.
steps.expect: Checklist names the failing check with owner and link; after fix it passes; period closes after MG approval; all stock and finance users notified.

steps.does: Try to issue an invoice dated inside the closed period.
steps.expect: Blocked with “accounting period is closed”; no entry created.

steps.does: Export journals, invoices and payments for the period.
steps.expect: Files download; Verifier’s totals match the database exactly.

steps.does: Request reopen with a reason; MG approves; make a correction; close again.
steps.expect: Period open then closed; the whole sequence is audited.

steps.does: Open the home dashboard and read every widget; click each to its destination.
steps.expect: Counts equal the Verifier’s queries; every link opens the right filtered page.

steps.does: Run margin per model, supplier performance, warranty exposure, receivables ageing and VAT summary; export each.
steps.expect: Totals reconcile to the database; exports open correctly and use the same filters.

steps.does: Pick ten random actions from the run log and find each in /admin/audit.
steps.expect: Each exists with actor, time and before/after values; encrypted fields never appear.

steps.does: Open /admin/jobs and review failed jobs and outbox backlog; export the audit log.
steps.expect: No failed or stuck jobs; export contains the run’s entries; the export itself is logged.

title: Security, permissions and concurrency
opens_when: Run complete (or at any time on a reset copy).

steps.does: Each role agent attempts its list of forbidden actions (section 9 matrix) through the interface and by typing addresses.
steps.expect: Controls hidden or disabled; addresses show 403; nothing changes in the database.

steps.does: Using each role’s token, call forbidden API endpoints and attempt direct table reads as the browser role.
steps.expect: Every forbidden call returns 403; encrypted columns are not readable; no cross-role data in responses.

steps.does: Two IS sessions try to reserve the last available unit at the same moment; double-click Post receipt; press Approve in two tabs.
steps.expect: One wins; the other gets a clear refusal; no duplicate rows.

steps.does: Two sessions edit the same PO; the second saves after the first.
steps.expect: Second sees “Updated by [name]” with Reload and Compare; nothing silently overwritten.

steps.does: Enter a wrong password five times; then a wrong authenticator code five times.
steps.expect: Account locks for 15 minutes with a generic message; Super Admin is alerted; a second QI agent session cannot bypass.

steps.does: Suspend an active user while that user is mid-session; revoke sessions; reset the authenticator.
steps.expect: The user is signed out within a minute and cannot sign in; reset forces re-enrolment; Management notified.

steps.does: Enter hostile and awkward data in text fields: script tags, SQL fragments, very long strings, Twi and accented characters, zero and negative quantities, huge amounts, extra decimals.
steps.expect: No script runs; validation messages are clear; Unicode stored and printed correctly; numeric limits enforced.

steps.does: Upload files of the wrong type, oversize files and the EICAR test file to documents, receipts and tickets.
steps.expect: Wrong or infected files blocked; oversize refused with message; no file served without a signed link.

steps.does: Start a receipt post, switch the browser offline mid-click, restore the connection, and refresh.
steps.expect: No duplicate ledger rows; the page shows the true state after reload.

steps.does: Open the address of a unit assigned to AT2, and the cost fields of a unit.
steps.expect: Access denied for AT2’s unit; costs hidden for technicians.

steps.does: Try to view a licence key as QI and FS; open a software licence through the API.
steps.expect: No key shown to roles without licence.view; the API response omits it.

steps.does: Compare every expected notification in section 11 against the notification table and the mail sink.
steps.expect: Each expected notification exists exactly once per recipient within 60 seconds; no unexpected recipients.

steps.does: Open every generated PDF (PO, GRN, shipment summary, dispatch note, invoice, credit note, warranty certificate, labels, quote).
steps.expect: Letterhead and numbers correct; totals add up; serials readable and scannable; no placeholder text; QR opens the record only after sign-in.

steps.does: Open every email in the sink.
steps.expect: No login or token links except invitations and resets; correct names, numbers and amounts; no personal data beyond need.

steps.does: Run an automated accessibility scan and a keyboard-only pass on twelve key pages.
steps.expect: No serious or critical violations; every primary flow completable by keyboard; focus visible.

steps.does: Load the volume seed and time list pages, dashboards, a 100,000-row export and a landed-cost run.
steps.expect: Lists ≤ 2 s; dashboards ≤ 2 s; export job ≤ 30 s; no timeouts.

steps.does: Restore the previous night’s backup into a scratch project and run assertions A-02, A-09 and A-20.
steps.expect: Restore completes within the recovery objective and assertions pass.
